changes: finding_add now populates a signatureTag even when the reviewer omits one — deriving a deterministic canonical candidate (pure core/signature-candidate.ts deriveSignatureCandidate from category/files/desc, folded through the existing registry resolveTag) — and records provenance via a new signatureTagSource ('auto' | 'confirmed') field on the Finding. Both fields are audit-only: excluded from the finding _hash / signFinding and from every gate (the critical invariant). The mechanical auto-candidate is an explicit FALLBACK; real signal quality comes from confirmed tags (LLM reviewers forward, the ③.5 backfill historically). Fixes the Baseline-A signature-degradation bottleneck for forward findings.
usage: No new command. When any finding is filed via finding_add, it now carries signatureTag + signatureTagSource: confirmed (reviewer/LLM supplied a tag) or auto (machine fallback). learning_scan then derives signals keyed on these tags; the ③.5 backfill will upgrade historical auto tags.
expectedOutcome: Every new finding's persisted record includes a non-empty signatureTag and a signatureTagSource flag, while the finding _hash/signature is unchanged.
actualTranscript: Smoke (15/15) confirms: no-tag => signatureTagSource='auto' + non-empty candidate; supplied tag => 'confirmed' + tag unchanged; blank/whitespace => treated as omitted (auto); and the finding _hash is BYTE-IDENTICAL via real signFinding with vs without the new fields. Verifier 36/36 incl. a negative self-test (exclusionCheckHasTeeth=true) proving it would catch a signFinding _hash regression. Full npm test green incl. process-fact-contract.
outcomeDiff: Matches expected: provenance captured, _hash invariant preserved.
limitations: The mechanical auto-candidate is degraded (same family as Baseline A) — it is a FALLBACK, not human-quality; real quality flows from confirmed tags. This story does NOT weight confirmed vs auto in finding-signals derivation (deferred), does NOT backfill historical findings (③.5), and adds no A/B (③.3) or effectiveness metric (③.4).
pitfalls: The single most important invariant: signatureTag + signatureTagSource MUST stay out of the finding _hash / signFinding (finding.ts is gate-critical) — attached AFTER _hash, never hashed. The auto candidate now flows into finding-signals localSignature for untagged findings (intended forward behavior, more specific than the old empty signature). Round 1 surfaced 3 countable review findings (resolved) → the degraded 3x1 review escalation was recorded per solo-operator policy; reviewer live-fire pollution findings were dismissed.
